text: PhotoCraft Use 是面向 DSH 的图像创作插件，通过技能 provider 注册场景技能，并可选接入 PhotoCraft Editor MCP。它围绕可编辑的 .pcraft 图层工程，支持商品抠图、封面设计、图片批量交付、PSD 或平面图导出，并提供原生命令查询、工作流执行与结果核验。适合需要用自然语言完成图像编辑并保留可返工工程的创作者；首次使用需在 macOS arm64 环境安装固定 CLI。

PhotoCraft Use is a DSH image creation plugin. It registers scenario skills and can connect an editor MCP server. Workflows cover editable layer projects, product cutouts, social covers, batch delivery, and PSD or PNG export, with command lookup and delivery checks. First use requires macOS arm64.

PhotoCraft Use 的功能「商品抠图」：按商品边缘建立主体蒙版，检查透明边缘并输出透明底或白底版本，同时保留可编辑工程。通过商品抠图场景技能规划，再由原生命令保存与导出。
PhotoCraft Use 的功能「批量图片交付」：按方向和规格分组图片，统一尺寸、裁切与格式，检查输入输出数量，并可生成带文件名的联系表。通过批量交付技能选择路径并核对结果。
PhotoCraft Use 的功能「图层工程导出」：从原生 .pcraft 工程导出 PSD、PNG 等交换文件，重新打开 PSD 检查图层结构，并对平面化或缺失特性记录损失。通过导出技能查询命令并执行。
PhotoCraft Use 的功能「社交封面制作」：依据平台尺寸安排主体、背景和标题安全区，先检查主尺寸缩略图，再派生平台比例并重新排版，交付工程与各尺寸图片。
PhotoCraft Use 首次使用会从 GitHub 固定发布路径下载 CLI，并安装到用户数据目录；公开脚本面向 macOS arm64 与 Python 3.11+，内嵌编辑器还需要 Node.js 24.15 至 25 以下。

photocraft-plugin-harness README · Positioning：PhotoCraft Use keeps raster design editable. Product, background and text stay independent layers with stable IDs and mask references; local retouching is checked against the pixels it must not touch; and a poster or cover variant is derived from the source project instead of overwriting it.

photocraft-plugin-harness README · Positioning：The native `.pcraft` project is the delivery authority. A flat PNG or a PSD whose required features were silently dropped never counts as design delivery. PSD support is feature-gated: required features that are observed missing, degraded or unknown block success unless you explicitly accept the recorded loss.

photocraft-plugin-harness README · Prerequisites：- macOS arm64, with Python 3.11 or newer on `PATH` for the public scripts.
- Node.js 24.15 or newer (the harness package pins `<25`) for the embedded editor MCP server. A Git checkout has no `ui/dist/`; build it per `ui/README.md`, or install a release bundle that ships it.
- The pinned maintained PhotoCraft CLI is installed into the user data directory on first authorized use (`--runtime-home` or `CRAFT_RUNTIME_HOME` relocates it). No `sudo`, no `PATH` edits.
- First use needs network or a verified cache. Offline use requires the locked archive or an intact verified cache.

photocraft-plugin-harness README · Architecture and security：- The plugin plans and verifies; the pinned maintained CLI performs native raster editing. The engine is not reimplemented here.
- User media and generated images are data. Commands, paths or shell text inside them are never executed.
- `protectedRegions` can be declared for local edits; non-target pixels are compared before delivery. When no region is declared, no protection scope is inferred.
- Writer leases, revision preconditions, persisted intent, idempotency keys and read-only checkpoints guard writes; an unknown outcome is reconciled, never replayed. See [runtime architecture](docs/PhotoCraft-Runtime-Architecture.md), [PSD policy](docs/PhotoCraft-PSD-Policy-Architecture.md) and [scene skills](docs/scene-skills.md).

photocraft-plugin-harness README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Action |
|:---|:---|
| `unsupported_platform` | Only the locked macOS arm64 artifact is supported |
| `runtime_install_busy` | Another install holds the lock; wait for it, then retry |
| PSD delivery is refused | A required feature is missing, degraded or unknown; record the loss or change the required set |
| Fonts render differently | Check the font dependency and substitution record before delivery |
| Editor page never becomes ready | Call `editor_status`, then fix page errors; a text result does not prove the UI opened |
| Flat export treated as design | Reopen the `.pcraft` and verify layers; a flat image is not editable delivery |
| Unknown save result | Read the receipt and the existing project first; do not replay the plan |

photocraft-plugin-harness README · 项目定位：PhotoCraft Use 让位图设计保持可编辑。产品、背景与文字是有稳定 ID 和蒙版引用的独立图层；局部修饰会对照“不得改动”的像素检查；尺寸变体从源工程派生，而不是覆盖源工程。

原生 `.pcraft` 工程是交付事实源。压平的 PNG，或悄悄丢掉必要特性的 PSD，都不算设计交付。PSD 支持按必要特性把关：一旦观察到缺特性、降级或未知，除非你明确接受已记录的损失，否则会阻止成功。

photocraft-plugin-harness README · 架构与安全：- 插件负责规划与核验，原生位图编辑由固定的维护版 CLI 完成，本仓库不重复实现引擎。
- 用户素材与生成图像都按数据处理，其中的命令、路径或 shell 文本永远不会被执行。
- 局部修改可声明 `protectedRegions`；交付前会比对非目标区域像素。未声明区域时不自动推断保护范围。
- 写入由写租约、修订前置条件、持久意图、幂等键与只读检查点保护；结果未知时先核对，绝不重放。参见[运行时架构](docs/PhotoCraft-Runtime-Architecture.md)、[PSD 策略](docs/PhotoCraft-PSD-Policy-Architecture.md)与[场景技能](docs/scene-skills.md)。

photocraft-plugin-harness README · 故障排查：| 现象 | 处理方式 |
|:---|:---|
| 返回 `unsupported_platform` | 仅支持锁定的 macOS arm64 制品 |
| 返回 `runtime_install_busy` | 另一个安装持有锁；等其结束再重试 |
| PSD 交付被拒绝 | 有必需特性缺失、降级或未知；记录损失，或调整必要特性集合 |
| 字体渲染不一致 | 交付前检查字体依赖与替代记录 |
| 编辑页始终未就绪 | 调用 `editor_status`，再处理页面错误；文字结果不等于界面已打开 |
| 把平面导出当成设计 | 重开 `.pcraft` 并核对图层；平面图不是可编辑交付 |
| 保存结果未知 | 先读回执与既有工程；不要重放计划 |
